history.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game animation SPRITE SHEET, transparent background. Primary request: make a genuinely animated FOUR-POSE WALK CYCLE in two isometric viewing directions for the exact character in the reference. Input image role: identity, outfit/markings and 3D rendering reference only. Preserve identity faithfully; produce new actual walking poses rather than repeat standing pictures. Layout: EXACTLY FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows (8 isolated full body sprites), intended canvas 2048 by 1024. One character per cell. No grid drawn. Same scale and foot baseline within each row; ALL feet and tails fully inside each cell, generous transparent margins. Fixed elevated isometric game camera about 30 degrees above ground. TOP ROW: front three-quarter view, moving diagonally DOWN-RIGHT (screen southeast, head and feet face down-right). BOTTOM ROW: rear three-quarter view, moving diagonally UP-RIGHT (screen northeast, back of head and torso visible, looking away toward upper right). Never face purely sideways. Within EACH row columns left to right show consecutive phases: 1 LEFT foot forward contact, right foot well behind; 2 left leg bearing weight, RIGHT knee visibly bent and swinging past; 3 RIGHT foot forward contact, left foot well behind; 4 right leg bearing weight, LEFT knee visibly bent and swinging past. First and third phases must have clearly opposite leg positions. Both legs always anatomically distinct and readable, actual articulated hips/knees/ankles. Arms naturally counter-swing to legs. Body and head stay the same dimensions and orientation across frames. Soft polished dimensional casual mobile garden game art, crisp silhouettes, gentle shading. No floor disc, scenery, base, text, labels, numbers, separators, frame border, arrows, watermark, extra limbs, static clones, rigid straight legs or strong glow. Keep all background truly transparent.
Character identity: ordinary young adult woman with dark brown bob hair, coral jacket, cream shirt, denim trousers and brown ankle shoes.
